system.description: The beneficiary climbs vertical walls. Climbing speed is calculated from movement at application: movement/2 + 1 m. Both hands and feet are required for full speed; normal carrying capacity is retained. Expiration while aloft causes a fall, handled by the GM. Ordinary ground movement is unchanged.
system.summary: Lets the Thuul climb walls and ceilings like a spider.
